description: Header file defining structures, constants, and function prototypes for TrueType character mapping (cmap) support in FreeType, including class definitions, validation functions, and cmap building routines.

classes.name: TT_CMapRec
classes.description: Structure representing a TrueType character map, including a pointer to cmap data and flags.

classes.name: TT_CMap_ClassRec
classes.description: Class structure defining cmap format, validation, and info retrieval functions.

classes.name: TT_ValidatorRec
classes.description: Structure for cmap validation, including number of glyphs.

methods.name: tt_face_build_cmaps
methods.description: Function to build character maps for a TrueType face.

methods.name: tt_get_cmap_info
methods.description: Function to retrieve cmap information for a given character map.
